note: The spec ids this engine can rank, and each one's fork proto Spec name. Shared because two languages need it: scripts/generate_json_literal_types.py emits the SpecId union from these keys (a JSON import would widen to string and prove nothing), and assemble_universe.py reads forkSpec to look items up in data/equip-eligibility.json. check_equip_eligibility.py gates that map as total and injective on every verify. The rest of each spec's facts -- cap profile, cutoff, preferred metas, class, tree, site path -- live in the typed sibling spec-registry.ts, which must stay total over these keys.
